info.title: Riverside Library: legitimate inline HTML in descriptions

tags.name: Catalogue
tags.description: A catalogue record. Shelf marks look like FI-204, where FI is the collection and 204 is the bay. Press Enter to search. The ISBN is optional for periodicals. Markdown equivalents of the same things: `FI-204`, *FI*, **204**. A list, which markdown produces as raw markup too: - hardback - paperback - audio And a link that must keep working: [the lending policy](https://example.invalid/policy).
